timingConvention: Turn values are zero-based runtime turn indices. Guided mode uses fixed values; professional and sandbox modes derive declared variants from the run seed.

events.label: Copper buyer early-payment offer
events.mechanism: Makes a USD 2.6 million advance available in exchange for a 5 kt later delivery obligation.

events.label: Regional stock return revised
events.mechanism: Replaces a preliminary regional stock report without changing the underlying stock.

events.label: Domestic crop estimate revised
events.mechanism: Publishes a revised estimate of the run's already-seeded modeled weekly domestic grain output.

events.label: Severe-weather port warning
events.mechanism: Announces the closure one turn in advance so the shock tests planning rather than surprise alone.

events.label: One-week port closure
events.mechanism: Removes weekly port throughput and leaves affected cargo in its queue.

events.label: Early-payment offer expired
events.condition: The offer's availability window closes without acceptance.

events.label: Copper delivery penalty
events.condition: An accepted early-payment delivery obligation remains unmet at its due turn.
events.mechanism: Settles an explicit USD 0.8 million penalty in the ledger.
